description: Atlas Honda Limited is a public listed company incorporated on 16 October 1962, and is a joint collaboration between Honda Motor Company Limited Japan and the Atlas Group. It is principally engaged in the progressive manufacturing and marketing of motorcycles and spare parts, with a production capacity of over 1.5 million units per annum, and also exports its motorcycles and spare parts to Bangladesh and Afghanistan.
headOffice: 1-McLeod Road, Lahore 54000, Pakistan (registered office); the Karachi plant at F-36, Estate Avenue, S.I.T.E., Karachi 75730 also operates as the head office
sourceNote: Written from: atlashonda.com.pk/the-company/ (The Company, Establishments, CEO's Message), atlashonda.com.pk/contact-us/ (accessed 2026-10-17)
